'''PK-4''' was a [[PK-series worker droid]] in service to the [[Trade Federation]]. It had [[Color|white]] plating and a green light on their back and utilized a [[wrench]]. PK-4 was present during the [[Battle of Naboo]]<ref name="LEGOMTT" /> in [[32 BBY]].<ref name="GA">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref>

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
PK-4 first appeared in a [[Content cut from Star Wars|deleted scene]] for the [[1999]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="TPMDel">{{Film|I}}</ref> The [[PK-4/Legends|droid]] was first [[canon]]ically mentioned in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity in ''[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace Illustrated Screenplay]]''.<ref name="Illus">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace Illustrated Screenplay|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace Illustrated Screenplay'']]</ref> It was introduced to the new canon in [[2014]] with the release of a [[LEGO]] set depicting a [[Multi-Troop Transport]].<ref name="LEGOMTT" />
